purpose: Evaluate relay convergence around the existing Mycelix-DeSci signed event stream under replay, reordering, equivocation, verification failure, missing predecessors, stream forks and cross-stream territorial conflicts.
event_hash_algorithm: BLAKE3 ContentHash over canonical Mycelix SignedScientificEvent; distinct from payload blob SHA-256
external_source_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 (Sol-Atlas source and record references; separate domain)
verifier_boundary: Verification assessments are detached and time-scoped; trusted time basis is required for verified/revoked conclusions. The harness does not authenticate assessment signatures, verifier trust or actor/authority authorization.
payload_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over exact stored serialized signed-event blob bytes

complexity_target.reconciliation_time: O((N + E) log N) or better; design target only, not measured
complexity_target.memory: O(N + E + C); design target only, not measured
complexity_target.conflict_output: compact groups, not all pairwise combinations

governance_frameworks: CARE Principles for Indigenous Data Governance (Global Indigenous Data Alliance; context-specific)
FAO Voluntary Guidelines on Responsible Governance of Tenure (voluntary guidance; non-binding)

interoperability_boundary.transparency_receipt_owner: Mycelix LEX-NET-028 / SCITT transparency work (#1215, #5942, PR #5944)
interoperability_boundary.cter_role: consume typed receipts/checkpoints; no CTER-owned VDS or witness ledger
interoperability_boundary.privacy_rule: no raw sensitive claim payloads to public transparency services; use reviewed high-entropy salted commitments where a transparency commitment is justified

conflict_group_semantics: one latest accepted event per stream and projection key; earlier same-stream events remain historical evidence
